nodes.question: What were the results in terms of environmental impact for participants with major reductions in ultra-processed food consumption?
nodes.answer: Participants with major reductions in their ultra-processed food consumption reduced their impact by -0.6 kg of CO2eq and -5.3 MJ of energy.
